workout.finisher: Incline walk · 10 min · 3.3–3.5 mph · 6–8% incline. Skip if session hits 65 min.
workout.coach_note: Upper day, clean split after Monday's lower. Legs get a break. Progressions are from your strong 7/3 upper — PF machines run heavy, calibrate to feel. Pulls pair horizontal (cable row) + vertical (lat pulldown). Keep the band external-rotation shoulder work you're doing on your own — good insurance with the pressing going up.

exercises.name: Flat DB Bench Press
exercises.note: 70 was confirmed clean on 7/3 (last rep hard, nothing left). Grab the 75s for set 1 and see how they move — if you get 8+ clean, stay at 75; if it's grindy, drop back to 70. Controlled eccentric, watch the left shoulder.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press Machine (PF)
exercises.note: You hit 70x12 on 7/3. Run 70 again but if you clear 12 on set 1, bump to 75 for the rest. Don't grind it if the left shoulder complains — that's the one to protect.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row (PF)
exercises.note: Start at 125 (you finished there 7/3). Horizontal pull. If all 3 sets of 10 are clean, next time start at 135. Squeeze the shoulder blades, no jerking.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (PF, neutral grip)
exercises.note: Neutral close grip — the one that let you move more. Start 125. Vertical pull, full stretch at the top, drive elbows down.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.note: Shoulder accessory. Lead with the elbow, stop at shoulder height. If time and the shoulder feels good, add Face Pulls at 30 lb x15 x2 for rear-delt/rotator health.

exercises.name: Arms Superset — Rope Pushdown + Hammer Curl
exercises.note: Rope tricep pushdown at 40 lb + hammer curls at 25 lb (rotating off last week's straight-bar curls for variety). Elbows pinned, controlled. 3 rounds.

exercises.name: Core Circuit (fresh combo) — 2 rounds
exercises.detail: Pallof Press 40 x10/side → Hanging Knee Raise x12 → Hollow Body Hold 25s
exercises.note: Different combo from your last sessions. Back's cleared so hollow body is fine — arms overhead, lower back pressed flat. Pallof on a cable at 40; sub a band if the cable's taken.
